responses: We offer a 30-day return policy on all unworn, unopened, and original condition items with tags attached.
You can initiate a return through your account dashboard within 30 days of delivery. Prepaid return labels are provided!
Items in original condition can be returned or exchanged within 30 calendar days of receipt for a full refund.
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days ($4.99 or free on orders over $50). Expedited 2-day delivery is $12.99.
We partner with FedEx, UPS, and DHL. Most orders placed before 2 PM EST are dispatched on the same business day.
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days, while expedited delivery arrives within 48 hours. Tracking is included on all shipments.

responses: If your payment was declined, please verify the expiration date and billing address, or try an alternative method like PayPal.
In case of duplicate charges, one is typically a temporary authorization hold that drops off automatically within 24-48 hours.
Please check with your issuing bank if payment errors persist, or try re-entering your card information in checkout.
